title: Verification and Expiry of the Documents a Keyturn Vehicle Listing Depends On
content:
A Keyturn Vehicle Listing depends on documents that expire, and each one is verified by the marketplace rather than accepted on the host's word. That authority is the standing rule of this desk: a document counts as verified when the marketplace's own record shows it checked against the vehicle it was filed for, and a host's assurance about a document is not a verification of it.

The host is warned the class's notice period in whole calendar days before a document expires, and where it expires without being renewed the listing is suspended on the day after the class's registration grace runs out.

Verification takes the class's verification period in business days counted from the day the document is received, and the listing stays live while verification runs where the document was received before the old one expired.

A document that fails verification is treated as absent, and a listing depending on it is suspended on the same footing as one that never supplied it.

A lender consent document is verified against the lender named on the title and not merely for its own consistency, so a consent from a lender the title does not name is not accepted.

Where a class accepts no out-of-state registration, a registration from another state is refused at verification rather than at listing, and the host is told which class would accept it.

### Points of judgement

*A registration received two days before the old one expires, in a class whose verification period is 3 business days.* Verification runs past the expiry date, and the listing stays live while it runs, because the document was received before the old one expired.

*The same registration received two days after the old one expired.* The condition for staying live is not met, the document having been received after expiry; the listing stands on the class's registration grace, at the end of which it is suspended on the following day.

*A consent naming a finance company that does not appear on the title.* It is not accepted, and the listing is in the same position as one that supplied no consent at all.
